item.title: How to Use a Terraform Provider to Deliver Iac-Level Applications
item.description: 1. Terraform Vs Kubernetes Infrastructure as Code (Iac) is built on immutable infrastructure: it uses orchestration tools to turn infrastructure into text, so you can manage infrastructure the way you manage code. In 2018 I was working on SaaS development, deploying on the Kubernetes platform, and that was the year Terraform was very hot.
